events.title: Court filing accusing a British royal becomes public
events.body: A Dec 30, 2014 motion in Jane Doe #1 and Jane Doe #2 v. United States (S.D. Fla.) alleged that Jeffrey Epstein forced a minor into sexual encounters with others, including a member of the British royal family. Press coverage and palace denials followed on Jan 2–3.

events.title: Boeing 727 to Paris, back via the Azores
events.body: Palm Beach to JFK to Paris, Feb 27–28. The return on Mar 9 left from Santa Maria in the Azores for St. Thomas.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed

events.title: Eight days across the Southwest
events.body: Palm Beach to Santa Fe, Phoenix, Boston and Teterboro, Mar 17–24, all on the Gulfstream.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed

events.title: Judge strikes the allegations from the record
events.body: A federal judge in Florida struck the January allegations as impertinent to the case, made no finding on whether they were true, and denied the motion to join the suit.

events.title: Ten days in Paris
events.body: Teterboro to Paris on Jun 30, back on Jul 9.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed

events.title: A private dinner with tech executives
events.body: The 727 flew from Albuquerque to San Jose for a dinner in Palo Alto on Aug 2, then left the next day. The dinner was not public at the time; it surfaced in emails released years later.

events.title: Paris, two weeks before the suit
events.body: Teterboro to Paris on Sep 7, back to Teterboro on Sep 13.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed

events.title: Giuffre v. Maxwell filed
events.body: A defamation suit filed in the Southern District of New York over a January 2015 statement that called the abuse allegations lies. It settled in 2017.

events.title: A same-day trip to MIT
events.body: Teterboro to Hanscom Field and back on Oct 24. MIT's 2020 fact-finding report records a fundraising visit that afternoon with Media Lab faculty and students. Gifts tied to him for one lab totaled $125,000 across 2015 and 2017.
events.source_label: MIT fact-finding report (Goodwin Procter, Jan 2020), p. 49

events.title: Boeing 727 to Paris, again back via the Azores
events.body: Newark to Paris on Nov 7. The return on Nov 13 left from Santa Maria in the Azores for St. Thomas, the same way home as in March.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed

events.title: December: the usual triangle
events.body: St. Thomas, Palm Beach and Teterboro, the three airports that dominate every year of these records.
events.source_label: FAA flight records (FOIA), via Epstein Exposed
